title: Head-to-head samples
intro: A pair (s, t) is real if a user on screen s can trigger a navigation that lands on t: a link, or a handler that calls the router directly, through helpers or through an injected service, in a component shown on s (the routed components, the shell above the outlet, what their templates include, dialogs they open), possibly after an await or behind a guard, the trigger being shown while the user stays on s. Spurious if no such trigger exists. Unclear if the source does not decide it. A route parameter may take any value; a redirect counts. The sites shown under an item are starting points, constructs a tool relates to the pair or to its target (no tool is named); they are not evidence either way, so read the source around and beyond them.
